title: Day and Trial Passes: holding multiple day or trial passes over time
content:
This document states the basis on which a visitor may hold Day and Trial Passes (Single Day Pass, Three-Day Trial Pass, Seven-Day Trial Pass, Weekly Visitor Pass, Monthly Trial Pass, Corporate Guest Pass) open over time.

## Rule
A visitor may hold any number of day or trial passes open over time. Where a given tier's per-tier rolling-year cap is set above zero, that tier may not be held beyond that cap within its rolling window; where a tier's per-tier rolling-year cap is zero, no cap applies to that tier at all. No separate maximum number of passes per customer is defined across tiers as a whole — this product line sets no blanket cross-tier ceiling; only the per-tier rolling-year cap, where one is set, limits how many passes of that same tier a visitor may hold open over time.

### Basis Q&A
**Can a visitor hold passes from more than one tier at the same time?** Yes; holding multiple tiers concurrently is not restricted by this policy, since no blanket per-customer cap exists across tiers.
**Does every tier carry the same limit?** No; each tier's own rolling-year cap (or absence of one) governs that tier alone.
